author: Aanszo
body:
The IGN : Laggeh 

Reason for ban : 'Lag Switching' 

Where do I start? I played avicus for about a year and enjoyed every time I played a game. The community was amazing and I met a lot of awesome new friends here. I watched a lot of things happen like avicore, Yoav and howsie quiting and even say the community worsen. Sad to say, the new moderators have also been getting worse and worse in finding hacks.

I guess what I'm trying to say is I love this server so much that I even payed 100 bucks to support it. If you are wondering why I took 2 months  to appeal, it's simply because after the ban,  I stopped playing minecraft altogether. Until my friend introduced me to BasicPvP I stayed away from minecraft for about 1.5 months. I then began recording again and got back into my 'addiction'  for minecraft pvp. Seeing Counterstrafes' 1v1s with some of these awesome people made me remember all the great times I had and, well, here I am.  I've never lag switched. Ever. Having a rank and spending so much time here and lag switch would be Idiotic. Until the accusations came, heck, I didn't even know what it was. To my understanding it's an Irl switch of some sort connected to your router.? I can assure you its my internet. I get 20mbps download and 15mbps upload speed. My internet is terribly bad. On top of that, my router is quite far from my pc and I can't just run there turn on the lag switch and run back in 1ms everytime I see a player.. I'm pretty sure it's just that the server needs more things to load (kb hits etc)..? I swear I've never cheated on avicus. Ever. I guess I should also mention I don't autoclick. If you want proof I can easily show you my jitter click on Skype. (On my phone, my mic for the pc isn't working). I miss this community so much even though it isn't as good as it used to be. It's still by far way better than other servers. If you need further proof and you can't just believe me, my download, .minecraft and anything else is yours. I have nothing to hide. You should know, I evaded ban for like 10 minutes. When my Tempban for 'autoclicker'  was finished and omega update already up and running I joined. 'permanent ban for Lag Switch' (not exact quote duh) I was very pissed off. I went on my friends alt to check it out but I knew if I evaded any more (after the 10 or so minutes) I would never be unbanned and walk among my friends as a 'free man'. I realise I must sound like a 7 year old whining about this and having 'crying'  about this like I lost a limb but this is all the truth. Just saying, I've been using WTFast again which actually gives me what I should get (250ms /4 bars). I barely lag if not at all. I never understood why it said 250ms when I clearly got a high 3 bar. I hope I hear from you soon. My Skype if you want to further discuss about this : live:imlaggingyt  EDIT : I'm praying I did this right. .

Regards,
